title: Rule 10b-5: no fraud or misleading statements when selling securities
rule: In connection with the purchase or sale of any security, Rule 10b-5 makes it unlawful to use any scheme to defraud, to make an untrue statement of a material fact, to omit a material fact needed to keep the statements made from being misleading, or to engage in any practice that operates as a fraud. It reaches exempt private offerings as well as registered ones, and the issuer answers for statements made on its behalf, oral or written.
changeWatch: Amendments to Rule 10b-5 or Supreme Court decisions on its scope.

sources.title: 17 CFR 240.10b-5, Employment of manipulative and deceptive devices
sources.quote: To make any untrue statement of a material fact or to omit to state a material fact necessary in order to make the statements made

sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Exempt Offerings
sources.quote: All securities transactions, even exempt transactions, are subject to the antifraud provisions of the federal securities laws.
